originalSourceText:
Q.1 A mass-spring-damper system has 𝑚 = 1 𝑘𝑔, 𝑏 = 6 𝑁· 𝑠/𝑚, and

      𝑘 = 9 𝑁/𝑚. Based on the characteristic equation, what type of

        response does this system exhibit?

      A) Underdamped

       B) Overdamped

       C) Critically damped

      D) Unstable

       Answer: C

       Refer to Lecture 21: Linear Control of Manipulators Slide 11

         characteristic equation 𝑚𝑠² + 𝑏𝑠 + 𝑘 = 0

                             𝑠2 + 6𝑠+ 9 = 0

       𝑏2 = 62 = 36; 4𝑚𝑘= 4 × 1 × 9 = 36;

       𝑏2 = 4𝑚𝑘; critically damped system.
